notes.subject: tok hait bilong em
notes.rationale: סודו: ‘tok hait / saut klia bilong Yahwe’ (KJV, JPS) o ‘klostu frendshipp’ (ASV, BSB) — tupela i stret, סוד em i sanap long saut hait

notes.subject: סודו
notes.rationale: Tok hait bilong Yahwe i stap wantaim ol man stret — sanap long ples bilong lukluk hait

notes.subject: samting i bagarapim bel bilong Yahwe
notes.rationale: תועבה em i samting i strongpela nogut long bel — Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok stret

translation: Long wanem, man i senisim rot i stap olsem samting i bagarapim bel bilong Yahwe; tasol wantaim ⟨את⟩ ol man i save wokim stret, em i save toktok long tok hait bilong em.
